description: The plot illustrates how Macro-F1 Score varies with the number of tokens for two methods, “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information,” with shaded bands around each line indicating variability. The x-axis is labeled “Number of tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.5 to 1.5 with labeled ticks at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4 (0.2 intervals). The y-axis is labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, uses a linear scale, and shows labeled ticks from 48 to 58 in steps of 2. The MATTER (ours) series is drawn as a solid pink line with circular markers; it starts near 55.1 at 0.5 tokens, dips slightly around 54.3–54.5 at 0.6–0.7, rises to about 57.0 at 0.8, is around 56.3 at 0.9, peaks near 57.9 at 1.0, then declines to about 55.4 at 1.1 and about 53.0 at 1.2, stays near 52.6–53.5 from 1.3 to 1.4, and ends around 50.9 at 1.5. The “w/o material information” series is a solid purple line with circular markers; it begins near 52.5 at 0.5, is about 52.6 at 0.6, rises to roughly 54.1 at 0.7, then is about 53.3 at 0.8–0.9, gradually decreases to around 52.9 at 1.0 and 52.8 at 1.1, is about 52.4 at 1.2 and 51.7 at 1.3, increases to about 53.3 at 1.4, and drops to roughly 47.9 at 1.5.
